name: Hedge any positions
summary: This EA opens hedge (opposite direction) positions against existing open positions to protect against adverse market moves. It monitors current open positions and automatically places counter-directional trades with configurable lot sizing and distance parameters, effectively creating a market-neutral exposure when activated.
summary_zh: 该EA针对现有持仓自动开立反向对冲仓位，以保护免受不利市场波动的影响。它监控当前未平仓位，并根据可配置的手数和距离参数自动放置反向交易，激活后可有效实现市场中性敞口。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是对冲现有的持仓头寸，通过在相反方向开仓来抵消原有敞口风险。入场条件是当检测到现有未平仓位时，在预设的距离处放置反向对冲订单。出场条件依赖于用户手动管理或通过原有仓位的止盈止损触发。仓位管理方面，对冲仓位的头寸规模可以配置，可能与原始仓位成比例或固定手数。资金管理较为简单，没有复杂的资金分配算法，主要依赖用户对对冲参数的合理设置。该策略本质上是一种风险管理工具，不追求盈利而是追求敞口中性化，适合在不确定行情中保护已有利润或限制亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is hedging existing open positions by opening counter-directional trades to neutralize directional exposure. Entry conditions trigger when the EA detects an existing open position and places an opposing hedge order at a configurable distance from the current price. Exit conditions are not inherently automated; they depend on the user's manual management or the stop-loss/take-profit levels of the original positions. Position sizing for hedge trades can be configured, potentially matching the original position's lot size or using a fixed ratio, providing flexibility in how much exposure is neutralized. Money management is straightforward without complex allocation algorithms, relying heavily on the user's proper configuration of hedge parameters such as lot multiplier and trigger distance. The strategy functions primarily as a risk management tool rather than a profit-seeking system, aiming for exposure neutrality which is particularly useful during uncertain market conditions to protect existing profits or limit potential losses.

parameters.name: HedgeDistance
parameters.description: 对冲距离（点数），对冲单与市价的间隔
parameters.description_en: Hedge distance in points from market price

parameters.name: HedgeLotMultiplier
parameters.description: 对冲手数倍数，相对于原仓位的比例
parameters.description_en: Hedge lot multiplier relative to original position

parameters.name: HedgeAllPositions
parameters.description: 是否对冲所有持仓，true=全部对冲，false=选择性对冲

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔数，用于标识EA所开仓位

pros: 能有效对冲现有仓位风险，在不确定行情中提供保护
操作简单直观，用户只需激活即可自动对冲所有持仓
手数倍数可配置，允许部分对冲或超额对冲，灵活度高
pros_en: Effectively hedges existing position risk, providing protection during uncertain market conditions
Simple and intuitive operation — users just activate it to automatically hedge all open positions
Configurable lot multiplier allows partial hedging, full hedging, or over-hedging for flexibility
cons: 对冲仓位本身也可能产生亏损，双倍点差和手续费成本
缺乏自动出场机制，对冲仓位需要手动管理或依赖原仓位止损
没有考虑相关性对冲，简单反向对冲在非对称波动中可能不完全有效
cons_en: Hedge positions themselves can incur losses, doubling spread and commission costs
Lacks automated exit mechanisms; hedge positions require manual management or rely on original position stop-losses
Does not account for correlation-based hedging; simple directional hedging may be ineffective under asymmetric volatility
improvements: 增加自动平仓机制，当原仓位关闭时自动关闭对应的对冲仓位
加入相关性分析和跨品种对冲功能，提升对冲效率
增加动态对冲距离和手数调整，根据市场波动率自动优化对冲参数
improvements_en: Add automatic closing mechanism that closes corresponding hedge positions when original positions are closed
Implement correlation analysis and cross-instrument hedging to improve hedging efficiency
Add dynamic hedge distance and lot adjustment based on market volatility to automatically optimize hedging parameters

risk_points: 对冲仓位如果管理不当可能导致双重亏损而非风险对冲
没有自动出场机制，对冲仓位可能在行情剧烈波动时失去对冲效果
risk_points_en: Improperly managed hedge positions can lead to double losses instead of risk reduction
Lack of automated exit mechanism means hedge positions may lose their hedging effectiveness during extreme market volatility

It monitors current open positions and automatically places counter-directional trades with configurable lot sizing and distance parameters, effectively creating a market-neutral exposure when activated.
